rules.rule: Create an independent project; do not reuse another site geometry, dimensions, sizes, classifications or metadata.

rules.rule: Register original sources, revisions and hashes; inspect visually, cache previews and retain source provenance.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Identify the actual existing building perimeter and wall faces before aligning overlays; check a connected, closed boundary.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Written survey dimensions govern. Do not infer replacement dimensions from PDF/photo scale.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Record the two referenced entities and internal/external/centreline datum; wall thickness is local to its stated wall.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: This engineer uses an under-dot to identify external measurements; check any conflicting source key.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Established beam-to-beam convention is centre-to-centre unless current survey instructions conflict.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: External dimensions and external gaps must reach actual outer faces, not an inner face or provisional footprint.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Account for every relevant source label; preserve corrections and explicit exclusions/unresolved values.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Black numeric mm dimensions and thin extensions/arrowheads, no INT/EXT labels; align chains and place near the relevant geometry.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Validate joined room walls, complete corridors, separate communal/private hallways and correct stair/flat doorway destinations.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Interpret line types using this site key; dashed lines do not have a universal structural meaning.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Confirmed load-bearing external and stair walls use heavy black lines; do not infer all new-site external walls are structural.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Show supplied member sizes/specifications; query unclear values; probable sizes remain unverified and missing values are null.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Estate-agent plans may inform topology/graphic fit, not metric surveyed interiors; apply latest confirmed orientation.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Correlate openings and access across photos and plans; do not move external windows to internal interfaces or infer hidden construction.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Keep plant-room-above and lower-level geometry distinct; omitted footprints still require accurate face references.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Inspect first, batch precise unanswered questions, retain exact answers and update all dependants without asking again.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: A3 landscape KA frame and project title block; roof title Roof Support Layout; no redundant plot title/banner/source footer.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Use KA compass at frame top-right, orientated by the GA north and the same plan transformation.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Key matches actual members/line weights, includes supplied specifications and omits Engineer-described survey line and removed clutter.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Use correct client/consultant artwork with provenance; no automatic redrawing or borrowing another client logo.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Requested PDF and DWG agree; check CAD round-trip and visual output. Declare NTS sheet coordinates rather than implying full-size model geometry.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Clear scoped superseded deliverables when requested; preserve original sources and decisions, other projects and normal Git history.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Pause named regeneration/publication when told; record independent corrections and resume when authorised.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections

rules.rule: Cache source selection and reusable formatting; use one record, consolidated clarifications and batch exports; track time and rework.
rules.authority: Engineer workflow discussion and reviewed Asmer/Honeypot corrections
